descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S25 Android emulator and iOS simulator on the local stack: events fire from the native app, and a device with the wrong date files them on the server's day

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U14 Per-day aggregation follows the server clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock set or another time zone files its events on the same day as any other device (UAT 3.8)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 AC 5)
  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2; TFA-94514 AC 4; TFA-94609 AC 7)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Debug builds of main bundled for the local stack: Android on the emulator (scripts/android-lane.ts, adb reverse 4510/4511) with the emulator set to a wrong date and another time zone; iOS on the simulator against the local stack (Xcode is installed) with the correct clock; a fresh @roundai.test account

When On each phone: see the baseline card, open a chart, complete and delete a task, mark the encounter complete, send a handoff and answer the follow-up

Then Every row from S01/S07 appears for each device; the wrong-date device's rows carry the same day as the other device's and land in the same pilotDailyRounding row

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8 ('Test with one device set to the wrong date') and OAT-06 Test 5/7. Code read: the day is the device's local date, so the wrong-date device is expected to differ; judged against 3.8 while Q3 is open

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
